summary: Iteration 5 — Security audit remediation verification. 27/27 pytest cases pass covering SEC-001 (empty login defaults, password NOT force-reset on restart confirmed by sudo supervisorctl restart backend, change-password endpoint 400/422/401), SEC-002 (CSV + XLSX formula injection prefixed with single quote for =, +, -, @; plain text untouched), SEC-003 (SameSite=Lax + Secure + HttpOnly + Path=/ at backend layer; see note on preview-edge rewriting), P3 hardening (SVG logo rejected 422, valid PNG accepted, null accepted, CORS_ORIGINS removed from .env), and regression (public survey, analytics all/today/7d/custom, responses pagination+filter, surveys CRUD, settings, QR PNG, exports, users list, branding GET, cron webhook auth+ok, RBAC blocks regular admin from users/branding/digest). Frontend verified via Playwright: AdminLogin input_value('')/''), served bundle.js contains 0 occurrences of 'AdminSurvey2026!', change-password modal opens from sidebar user-chip, mismatched confirm shows 'Konfirmasi password tidak cocok.', all nav links clickable, public survey loads.
action_items: (Low) Stale frontend production build at /app/frontend/build/static/js/main.86a93fb7.js STILL contains the hard-coded 'AdminSurvey2026!' literal from a pre-fix build. The actually-served dev bundle (bundle.js, 4.1MB) has 0 occurrences — but if the project ever deploys from /app/frontend/build without rebuilding, the leak would resurface. Recommend: delete the stale build/ directory or re-run `yarn build` so the artifact matches the fixed source.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:214 correctly uses response.set_cookie(..., samesite='lax', secure=True, httponly=True, path='/'). Verified against local backend on :8001 — Set-Cookie is 'SameSite=lax; Secure; HttpOnly; Path=/'. The public URL serves 'SameSite=None; Partitioned' because the preview-env edge proxy (Cloudflare) rewrites cookies for cross-site preview; application-layer fix is in place and this is NOT a code bug.

server.py:160-162 seed() correctly branches: creates admin if absent, only ensures super_admin role on existing doc, NEVER re-hashes/overrides password. Verified live by rotating the password, restarting backend via supervisorctl, and confirming old password returns 401 while new succeeds. SEC-001 fully closed.

server.py:120-126 sanitize_cell is applied to every attacker-controlled column (id, rating_label, comment) in both CSV and XLSX exporters. Confirmed CSV output has '=HYPERLINK..., '+1+2, '-SUM..., '@cmd prefixes. XLSX combined XML also contains these prefixes. Note: TAB/CR leading chars are already stripped upstream by ResponseIn.valid_comment() (.strip()), so they cannot reach the exporter — sanitizer still covers them defensively, good.

server.py:110-118 BrandingIn.check_logo whitelists png/jpeg/webp/gif data URLs only; SVG correctly 422s with 'Logo harus PNG, JPEG, WebP, atau GIF'. null/empty passes through as None. Good whitelist approach.

server.py:223-229 POST /auth/change-password: 401 unauthenticated (via current_admin dependency), 400 'Password lama tidak sesuai.' on wrong current password, 422 on new_password<8 via Pydantic. Writes password_changed_at timestamp. Correct.
/app/backend/.env no longer contains CORS_ORIGINS line — grep confirmed. Dead env var removed.

App.js:59-60 AdminLogin uses useState('') for both fields. autoComplete='username' and autoComplete='current-password' present. ChangePasswordModal is clean, has all required data-testid attributes, and client-side validates length>=8 and confirm-match before POST.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of security fix UI flows + regression nav

seed_data_creation: Submitted 5 public survey responses with formula-injection comments (=HYPERLINK, +1+2, -SUM, @cmd, 'Good service') via /api/responses. These remain in DB; they are harmless since the sanitizer prefixes them in exports. Short-lived test regular-admin user created and deleted via RBAC fixture.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SEC-003 cookie assertions MUST test against local backend http://localhost:8001 (not the public URL) because the preview edge proxy rewrites SameSite=Lax to SameSite=None; Partitioned. Password-rotation test uses sudo supervisorctl restart backend — ensure sandbox permits it (did in iteration 5). The admin password MUST be restored to AdminSurvey2026! at end of any rotation test. If re-seed is ever needed: delete the users doc for admin@survey.local in Mongo and restart backend. The /app/frontend/build/static/js/main.86a93fb7.js artifact is stale and still carries the old hard-coded password — not blocking (dev-served bundle.js is clean) but worth cleaning up.
rca of the issue: No regressions. Initial test iteration had 4 superficial failures: (1) SEC-003 cookie — public URL cookies get rewritten by Cloudflare edge from SameSite=lax to SameSite=None; Partitioned. RCA: infrastructure cookie rewrite for cross-site preview compatibility. Mitigation: test against localhost:8001 which is the direct FastAPI response — confirmed SameSite=lax; Secure; HttpOnly; Path=/. (2) CSV TAB-prefix — ResponseIn.valid_comment calls value.strip(), stripping leading \t before persist, so sanitizer never sees it. Not a bug; TAB payload removed from test matrix. (3) XLSX sharedStrings missing — openpyxl inlines short strings in sheet1.xml rather than sharedStrings.xml. Fix: scan combined XML across all .xml members for the sanitized prefixes.
